command: set -o pipefail; for u in frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; do echo UNIT:$u; systemctl --user show "$u" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p MainPID -p NRestarts -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; PID=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value); if test "${PID:-0}" -gt 0 && test -r /proc/$PID/environ; then echo ENV:$PID; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$PID/environ | grep -E '^(LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID|LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER|FRANK_VOICE_MACHINE_ID|FRANK_VOICE_OWNER|FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION|XDG_RUNTIME_DIR)=' || true; fi; journalctl --user -u "$u" -n 25 --no-pager 2>&1 | tail -25; done
